What's new in 0.21.1

• Live TV no longer crashes: your channels load first and are saved on the TV (refreshed once a day), then the TV guide loads once a day, keeping only your channels.
• Categories switch instantly.
• Sports: rest on a match for 3 seconds to find which channels show it, or press OK to go straight there.
• Live TV: move up and down the channel names; hold OK on one to favourite it; OK on a later show sets a reminder.
